definitions.Interval: structure with lo hi : Rat; Ordered means lo <= hi; Mem a x means (a.lo:Real)<=x and x<=(a.hi:Real)
definitions.rowTrace: chronological fold of rounded ryRow on one row pair with true real RY pair recurrence

signatures: outward_mem (a : Interval) (bits : Nat) (x : Real) (hx : Mem a x) : Mem (outward a bits) x
outward_widening (a : Interval) (bits : Nat) : a.lo-1/grid bits < (outward a bits).lo and (outward a bits).lo <= a.lo and a.hi <= (outward a bits).hi and (outward a bits).hi < a.hi+1/grid bits
times_mem (a b : Interval) (x y : Real) (hx : Mem a x) (hy : Mem b y) : Mem (times a b) (x*y)

ryRow_mem (theta : Rat) (n bits : Nat) (u v : Interval) (x y : Real) (hu : Mem u x) (hv : Mem v y) : Mem (ryRow theta n bits u v).1 (cos(theta/2)*x-sin(theta/2)*y) and Mem (ryRow theta n bits u v).2 (sin(theta/2)*x+cos(theta/2)*y)
midpoint_error (a : Interval) (x : Real) (hx : Mem a x) : abs(x-(midpoint a:Real)) <= ((a.hi-a.lo)/2:Rat)
rowTrace_mem (angles : List Rat) (n bits : Nat) : same pair enclosure preserved by chronological fold, with no intermediate midpoint
